intro: Where Persona's data comes from, and what it can act on for you. The assistant, AI twin, and agents use these to check your calendar, read messages, and send email, and they ask you before acting on your behalf. This iPhone (contacts, calendar, reminders, photos, health, location) is only available in the phone app, not on the web.
mail_footer: Accounts live on the hub. Passwords are stored encrypted and never sent back. The Inbox, assistant, and AI twin share them. You can also just tell Persona "add my email account."
gmail_body: Gmail uses Sign in with Google, not a password. After you authorize, Google returns to the Persona app on your iPhone, which the web can't receive. On your phone, open Settings › Connectors › Mail › Add account › Gmail. Once it's added, it shows up here and in the Inbox.
lark_hint: Lark Mail: the servers are always imap.larkoffice.com:993 and smtp.larkoffice.com:465 (SSL), so just enter your address and password. Use the third-party client password from Lark Mail settings.
imap_hint: QQ, 163, Outlook, iCloud, and others fill in the servers from the domain. Chinese providers usually need an app password (授权码) rather than your sign-in password.
smtp_tls: SMTP uses STARTTLS on 587 and SSL on other ports.
use_inbox_detail: DMs, @mentions, group messages, and mentions in Docs. AI sorts them first and drafts replies
use_knowledge_detail: Chats, people, groups, and projects are archived as context for the assistant and AI twin
use_assistant_detail: Persona can search messages and read docs. It asks on your phone before sending messages or making other changes
use_agent_detail: Start a message with /agent anywhere in Lark to have an agent handle it and reply for you
account_quarantined: Can't open. Retry or remove it in lark-connector
lark_footer_unconfigured: The hub isn't connected to Lark yet. Run lark-connector on the hub machine and add it under lark in hub.json (docs/feishu.md).
lark_footer: Lark accounts sign in through lark-connector on the hub machine. This only shows the connection status.
accounts_note: All signed-in accounts feed the Inbox, and you can switch accounts on the Messages page. /agent, the assistant, and the knowledge base use the default account. Add or sign out of accounts in lark-connector.
